**Best move:** gxf4+

**Main line:** gxf4+ Kxf4 Kxd7 Kg5

**Motif:** intermezzo (check inserted before expected recapture) + hangingPiece

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent leaves a piece undefended, don't just capture it directly—look for a forcing move first. Here, gxf4+ gives check, forcing the king to recapture. Only then can you take the hanging bishop. This "in-between" move gains the extra tempo you need to win material cleanly. Always scan for checks before quiet captures.
